poc_plan: Goal: Validate Dedicated for steady-state cost, meet 95th percentile latency <= 450ms for chat, support graceful fallback to cheaper model variant under capacity pressure.
Scope: small Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) in NA with identical canary in EU (single-region test then cross-region failover)
Canary steps: deploy model variant v1 (fp16 quantized), route 10% production-like traffic for 72 hrs, collect latency/cost/trace data

Fallback routing: primary route -> preferred model (high quality); on latency or queue threshold breach route to fallback model variant (smaller quantized) in same region; if region degraded, failover to secondary region's compatible variant

Rollback plan: automated health checks every 60s; if error rate > 2% or 95th-latency > 1s for 10m, automated rollback to previous model version + notify on-call; manual rollback playbook for config mistakes
Observability: per-token cost, per-request traces, token-level latency, request sampling for quality checks (golden prompts)
technical_requirements: SLOs: 95th pct latency <= 450ms for typical chat sessions, p99 <= 1s acceptable for complex prompts
Throughput: expected 120 reqs/sec peak, average 40 reqs/sec; burst up to 250 reqs/sec for 5-10 min
Model choices: prefer open variants (compatible with Redwood verified catalog). Candidate stack: Llama2-Chat-like high-quality variant + smaller 7B fallback for degradation
Networking: VPC peering + egress whitelist, support for customer KMS (wrap/unwrap) for key management
Data controls: opt-out telemetry, 12-month retention for audit logs, ability to restrict embeddings storage residency to eu-west region
acceptance_criteria: Latency and throughput targets met during canary window (see SLOs)
Cost model validated: Dedicated committed pricing yields >=25% reduction vs hosted spikes at expected usage pattern
Fallback behavior verified: user-visible error rate <0.5% during simulated capacity constraint tests
Security checklist signed: SOC2 doc, KMS integration verified, audit logging configured
Operational runbook tested: automated rollback and on-call notification exercise completed
pricing_notes: Initial Redwood proposal: baseline Dedicated pool with commit (monthly) + burst credits. Need a carve-out for burst to handle seasonal spikes.
